query:
-- Estoque atual por galão
SELECT id, gallon_number, stock_liters, last_price_per_liter
FROM gallon_stock
ORDER BY gallon_number;

-- Compras de combustível (fuel_purchases)
SELECT id, gallon_number, liters, price_per_liter, total_cost, created_at
FROM fuel_purchases
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 10;
